items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Look at this pictures and since we're going to get to that In The Mood thing, there's Plas Johnson... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: But I'll never forget, we were going in early that morning and he told me--of course I had got acquainted with him before, he said we have to get this. One other thing--but ask what you want while I'm thing about what I wanted to say.
Look at this pictures and since we're going to get to that In The Mood
thing, there's Plas Johnson, there's your son, Ernie, Jr., there's Earl Palmer and Rene Hall and yourself. Of course those three guys-- Earl Palmer was the number one drummer for years.
